prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one wide editorial concept illustration for an academic museum interaction design website. Show a coherent four-panel storyboard in a clean warm watercolor and fine pencil style with pale ivory background, muted sage, terracotta, indigo and gold. Landscape, wide composition. Consistent compact accessible tabletop station in all panels. No text at all, no letters, no numerals, no logos, no speech bubbles. Panel 1: seated visitor in casual clothes uses hands to lay three ordinary soft fabric pieces on a light neutral mat, beneath a simple overhead document camera. A small upright source reference card depicts an explicitly generic invented patchwork geometry, not a real museum artwork. Panel 2: close view of monitor alongside the same fabric layout, monitor shows two framed image areas, one small generic source swatch and one large AI-like textile image clearly based on the three fabric positions. Hands are off mat for a snapshot. Panel 3: visitor sees that digital result and deliberately moves one indigo fabric piece to reopen a gap, same document camera and monitor visible, obvious visual action and feedback. Panel 4: monitor shows the earlier and revised textile images side by side, with the second retaining the reopened gap, and the visitor points at the difference. Keep the physical fabric and digital artwork visually distinguishable. Use natural hands, no extra fingers. Focus on material action and visual response, not writing or typing. No robot, no humanoid AI, no VR headset, no laser projections. Equal panel widths with whitespace separators, generous margins. This is an imagined design storyboard, not documentary photography or evidence of a deployed system.
scope: Concept illustration only. Invented source and layouts. Three other diagrams are original SVG layout sketches, not generated results.
